name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: prefix data_fd2_, domain graphics, descriptor accurately describes a chapter ambient palette-animation index/counter. The 'idx' token reflects the data type (a 0..3 phase index). No Ghidra address residue (no _53c0b / hex tail). Name correctly mirrors purpose and type.
purpose: Runtime slow-cycle palette-animation phase index (0..3) for chapter ambient/idle animated tiles; selects which palette/tile-frame the scene compositors paint.
logic_summary: Advanced by fd2_tick_chapter_palette_animation @0x1297D: when (signed) BIOS-tick delta vs data_fd2_graphics_chapter_ambient_palette_anim_tick_latch (0x53C0F) exceeds 4 (or goes negative), INC then wrap (CMP ==4 -> reset 0) and re-latch the tick. Live value therefore stays 0..3. Read by 9 scene/HUD/overlay compositors as the ambient animated-tile frame selector; the hottest reader (fd2_composite_battle_tile_map @0x121CF) computes idx/2 for tile-attr-flag 0x10 tiles (chapter palette half-step). Companion fast cycle is data_fd2_graphics_chapter_walk_anim_alt_palette_idx @0x53C07 (advanced every call).
datatype: int32 (signed). Live value range 0..3. Ghidra type undefined4 (4-byte).
element_semantics: Scalar: current phase of the slow 4-step (0..3) chapter ambient palette-animation cycle. Indexes the animated palette/tile frame chosen by the compositors.
notes: Verified: writer disasm @0x129ac shows INC/CMP==4/MOV 0 on dword ptr [0x53c0b] (pure 0..3 cycle, 32-bit). Reader @0x121cf shows the signed divide-by-two idiom (MOV EAX,[0x53c0b]; MOV EDX,EAX; SAR EDX,0x1f; SUB EAX,EDX; SAR EAX,1) confirming canonical signed int32. The only WRITE/READ_WRITE xrefs are inside fd2_tick_chapter_palette_animation; the other 13 xrefs are READ -> game writes it each frame, so is_const=false. src comment (palette.c lines 60-74) is accurate and precise (slow cycle, every-4-tick advance, signed int32 + SAR evidence, zero-init .object2 scalar) -> keep. Ghidra has both a PRE_COMMENT and a PLATE_COMMENT; both are consistent with src and not contradictory/outdated/empty -> plate left untouched (action=none).
